prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet moment at an airport gate. On the left, a woman in a blue coat stands holding a boarding pass, her posture relaxed yet attentive. Next to her, a small child in a yellow hat points excitedly toward the large window, drawing attention to the tarmac outside. In the center, an elderly man in a gray suit sits on a metal bench, his head tilted back in sleep, oblivious to the surrounding activity. Beside him rests a worn leather suitcase, its handle slightly frayed from years of travel. To the right, a uniformed gate agent with short hair looks down at a tablet device, checking flight details with focused precision. Standing near the agent is a tall potted plant with broad green leaves, adding a touch of nature to the sterile environment. The woman in the blue coat is handing a small toy to the child in the yellow hat, creating a tender connection between them. Meanwhile, the elderly man in the gray suit is sitting on the metal bench, his legs crossed comfortably. There is no digital clock visible on the wall, leaving the sense of time ambiguous and reliant on the urgency of the travelers. The soft washes of pale blue and beige highlight the contours of the figures without overwhelming the delicate pencil lines that define their forms. The composition balances the stillness of the sleeping traveler with the gentle motion of the mother and child, while the gate agent remains a static anchor on the right side of the frame.
